text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian parliament deputies to elect 27 presidents of the courts of law.
- Orthodox epiphany celebration in Macedonia this weekend. The main event was when Macedonian archbishop Mihail threw the holy cross into the waters of the Vardar river.
- Low value of Bulgarian currency attracts Macedonians who travel to Bulgaria every weekend and practically empty shops in Bulgaria's border towns.
- Local election poll in village of Mala Recica, near Tetovo, again postponed due to quarrels between members of ethnic Albanian PDP and PDPA parties.
- Interior minister Tomislav Cokrevski said investigation into attempted assassination of President Gligorov has not stopped.
- Head of OSCE mission in Macedonia said Macedonia demonstrated impressive stability in such unstable surroundings.
